loudness.title: Loudness
loudness.ok: Overall {lufs} LUFS, 3 s max {st} LUFS. Mastering sets the rest.
loudness.silent: No sound at all. Check that the tracks aren't muted.
loudness.quiet: The mix is very quiet ({lufs} LUFS). Turn the tracks up.
loudness.hot: The mix is already very loud ({lufs} LUFS). Leave room for mastering.

balance.title: Vocal vs beat
balance.ok: The vocal is {lu} LU against the beat. That's right.
balance.noBeat: There's no beat in the project, so nothing to compare the vocal with.
balance.noVocal: There's no vocal in the project. Record one or set a track role.
balance.vocalBuried: The vocal gets lost in the beat ({lu} LU). Turn the vocal up or the beat down.
balance.vocalTooLoud: The vocal is much louder than the beat ({lu} LU). The beat sounds like background.
balance.vocalLow: The vocal is a bit too quiet against the beat ({lu} LU).
balance.vocalHigh: The vocal is a bit too loud against the beat ({lu} LU).

presence.title: Word clarity
presence.na: No vocal or beat to compare.
presence.ok: The words are clear. In the speech range the vocal leads by {db} dB.
presence.weak: The words are hard to make out. The vocal leads the speech range by only {db} dB.
presence.covered: The beat covers the words (speech range {db} dB). The vocal needs room.

masking.title: Masking
masking.na: No vocal or beat to compare.
masking.ok: The beat rarely covers the vocal ({pct}% of the time).
masking.some: The beat sometimes covers the vocal ({pct}% of the time).
masking.heavy: The vocal blends into the beat {pct}% of the time.

sibilance.title: Sibilance (s, sh)
sibilance.ok: The s and sh sounds are natural.
sibilance.some: The s and sh sounds are a bit sharp ({db} dB).
sibilance.harsh: The s and sh sounds hurt the ears ({db} dB).

clipping.title: Clipping
clipping.clipped: The recording clips ({events} spots). Turn the track down or record quieter.
clipping.overPeak: The mix goes over 0 dB ({tp} dBTP). Turn the tracks or the master down.
clipping.fewClips: A few short clips ({events}). Turn the loudest track down a little.
clipping.lowHeadroom: Little headroom for mastering (peak {tp} dBTP). Turn the mix down 2–3 dB.

noise.title: Background noise
noise.na: Not enough recorded vocal to judge noise.

stereo.title: Stereo
stereo.ok: Stereo is healthy (correlation {corr}). It will sound fine on a phone too.
stereo.wide: The mix is very wide (correlation {corr}). Something may vanish on a single speaker.
stereo.phase: The channels cancel out (correlation {corr}). Part of the sound will vanish on a phone.

panorama.title: Ad-libs and doubles
panorama.ok: Ad-libs and doubles are spread to the sides and the lead vocal is centred.
panorama.noAdlibs: No ad-libs or doubles. The lead vocal is centred.
panorama.leadOffCentre: The lead vocal isn't centred ({names}). Move it to the middle.
panorama.adlibsCentred: Ad-libs sit in the middle ({names}). Spread them to the sides.
panorama.oneSide: All ad-libs are on one side. Spread them left and right.

notes.chainFull: “{track}” already has 8 effects, so I didn't add anything there.
notes.gainClipTrack: I turned “{track}” down {db} dB because it was clipping. Now it has headroom.
notes.gainTrimTrack: I turned “{track}” down {db} dB so it doesn't hit zero.
notes.gainMasterDown: I turned the whole mix down {db} dB to leave headroom for mastering.
notes.gainMasterUp: I turned the whole mix up {db} dB because it was too quiet to work with.
notes.balanceVocalUp: I turned your vocal up {up} dB and the beat down {down} dB so your vocal sits on top.
notes.balanceVocalDown: I turned the vocal down {down} dB and gave the beat {up} dB so the beat doesn't sound like background.
notes.balanceSideDown: I turned “{track}” down {db} dB. It should sit about {under} dB under the lead so it doesn't cover the words.
notes.balanceSideUp: I turned “{track}” up {db} dB. You should hear it, about {under} dB under the lead.
notes.compLead: I added a compressor on “{track}” ({ratio}:1). Your vocal stays even and the words don't get lost.
notes.compSide: I added a gentle compressor on “{track}” ({ratio}:1) so it sits evenly in the back.
notes.eqBeatCut: I turned the beat “{track}” down {db} dB in the mids (around 2.5 kHz) so your vocal sits better.
notes.eqVocalHighpass: I cut the rumble below {hz} Hz on “{track}”. The vocal sounds cleaner and the bass has room.
notes.eqVocalPresence: On “{track}” I took out some boom (250 Hz) and added 2 dB of clarity (3.5 kHz).
notes.deesserSoft: I added a de-esser on “{track}”. The s and sh sounds are softer.
notes.deesserStrong: I added a stronger de-esser on “{track}”. Harsh s and sh sounds don't sting anymore.
notes.denoiseGate: I added a gentle gate on “{track}”. Noise in the pauses is quieter (up to {db} dB).
notes.denoiseRumble: I also cut low noise below {hz} Hz on “{track}”.
notes.panLeadCenter: I put “{track}” in the centre. The lead vocal belongs in the middle.
notes.panLeft: I moved “{track}” left ({pct}%) to make room for the lead vocal.
notes.panRight: I moved “{track}” right ({pct}%) to make room for the lead vocal.
notes.spaceLead: I added a short echo ({note} note, {ms} ms at {bpm} BPM) and a light reverb on “{track}”. The vocal isn't dry and the words stay up front.
notes.spaceSide: I added reverb ({decay} s) and an echo in time with the beat ({note} note, {ms} ms) on “{track}”. Your adlibs make space behind you.

fix.clipping: Clipping: pull the clipping track's volume down 3–6 dB. If the recording itself clips, record that part quieter.
fix.balance: Vocal vs beat: move the vocal or beat volume until the vocal is 0–3 LU above the beat.
fix.presence: Clarity: turn the vocal up or the beat down 2–3 dB. In the vocal EQ, lift around 3 kHz a little.
fix.masking: Masking: turn the beat down 2 dB or cut its mids (1–4 kHz) in the beat EQ.
fix.noise: Noise: record somewhere quieter, closer to the mic. Noise removal comes in the next stage.
fix.sibilance: Sibilance: angle the mic slightly away from your mouth or lower the highs (6–8 kHz) in the vocal EQ.
fix.stereo: Stereo: check no track is phase-inverted and narrow the widest tracks.
fix.panorama: Panorama: keep the lead vocal centred, pan ad-libs left and right by 30–60.
fix.loudness: Loudness: set the faders so the mix is neither too quiet nor clipping.
